attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.10.0 cluster (Erlang 23.3.4.11, installed via official packagecloud repos on RHEL7), created the `payments` virtual host, and created `app_user` (password generated on-node via openssl, tags=none for least-privilege AMQP-only access) with full configure/write/read permissions on `payments`. Created a durable quorum queue `orders` replicated across all three nodes. Demonstrated message survival: published a persistent message, stopped the queue leader (node1), confirmed leadership failover to node2 and the message remained available, consumed it successfully from node2 while node1 was down, then restored node1 and confirmed full cluster recovery. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured boot_id + service-active baselines on all 3 nodes, then sequentially rebooted node1, node2, and node3 (one at a time, waiting for full cluster health/quorum before proceeding to the next), verifying a changed boot_id and full RabbitMQ cluster rejoin + quorum queue integrity after each. Final end-to-end publish (node1)/consume (node3) test after all restarts succeeded, and app_user's tags were reverted to `none` for production use.
